Welcome to the graduate student website for the Department of Mathematics. Here you can find information about our graduate programs, as well as resources for current and future students. Use the tabs above to identify yourself as a current or future student.
Graduate Student Spotlight
Bio Item
Lynn Bruncati
, bio
Lynn’s research focuses on mathematical biology, specifically using systems of differential equations to model how environmental conditions affect populations of Culex pipiens, a mosquito species that transmits West Nile virus. Their research advisor is Michael Robert. Beyond their research, Lynn is actively involved in the academic community as president of Spectra at Virginia Tech, a graduate peer mentor, a member of the Virginia Tech Pride Council, and an admissions interviewer for their alma mater.
